# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux architecture support changes**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp release drops packaged native assets for 32-bit Linux x86.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer included in NuGet packages. Move 32-bit Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading; applications that still require those assets must remain on an earlier release that supplies them. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
